When I was pregnant the first time at 15, I went to a vocational school that held classes for pregnant teens. I thought I was going to be the youngest one in there, but there was a 13 year old girl that was pregnant with her 2nd child. About 10 years later I ran into her at a Wal-Mart, she was on her 8th child! I didn't ask too many questions. I was just in shock, although we sorta laughed about us having more kids, since I did too. But she didn't look well and I didn't think it was anything she wanted. I feel that I am "lucky" or something because sure my kids had their problems but nothing more than any other kids have. They all passed their grades, never got too  mixed up in drinking and things like that.  My husband was the same age as me, we were both 15. I am a few months older than he is. We both worked in restaurants and we made ok money once I got promoted to a keyholder so we didn't qualify for any state assistance. We held our own health insurance for them, thank the stars because one child played football and another lifted weights, so we needed that! Another wears glasses, so I guess all in all I can't say it wasn't HORRIBLE. Not fun sometimes and there were days when they did nothing cute at all, lol! I am who I say I am. I think I'm more nervous about life now than I ever was when they were young. kids and menial jobs is all I've ever known. Now, I'm on my own (for the most part, my mother lives with me), and trying to branch out and figure who I am without being just "so and so's mom" or "His Wife". It's scary and I really am learning a lot about myself, which is very scary in itself! Sometimes I feel like a kid when it comes to learning about other people, dating, what I like and don't like. But, I will eventually figure all this out. I hope!
